items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...our good friend Joe Williams received a — [INTERVIEWEE] Yes he did, an honor one year.

ctx.x: Yes it was. A great gig.
Gee. I was interested to see you also have some involvement with the Society of Singers where our good friend Joe Williams received a —

Yes he did, an honor one year. Well the Society of Singers started because Ella Fitzgerald and Frank Sinatra used to be approached by singers in need. Like Louis Armstrong and Duke and many of them were approached by musicians in need. And they decided it would be a wonderful thing if they could get something going where a singer could, with some dignity, could approach an organization and get some help. So a man by the name of Bud Granoff, who used to work for Frank Sinatra, was a very successful publisher…
